planets.name: V1298 Tau c
planets.description: Transiting planet of V1298 Tau with a 8.25-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: V1298 Tau c was found in 2019 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around V1298 Tau. Its orbit and size follow Livingston et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
